tasks.name: Component C: seam-independent daemon surface with integrate/reopen markers
tasks.description: commit_worker records a persistent finalize_failed event on a preserved finalization failure and a finalize_integrated marker on success; recover_worker_integration records finalize_integrated on an integrated result and finalize_reopened on a reopen_for_edit result. TDD.
